sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select title,owner,status,reason from feedback.attention order by title

sections.title: Verified account demand
sections.note: Revenue associated with requests, not predicted revenue. Compare within each currency.
sections.sql: select title,status,effort,currency,supporting_accounts,linked_mrr as monthly_revenue,mrr_per_effort as revenue_per_effort from feedback.demand order by currency,mrr_per_effort desc

sections.title: Release follow-up
sections.sql: select title,account,owner,due_on from feedback.close_loop order by due_on

sections.title: Scoped checks
sections.note: Business review dates, not legal deadlines. See docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select title,rule,finding,source from feedback.privacy_checks order by title,rule
